documents.title: 800V EV platform readiness
documents.content: 800V electric vehicle platforms are moving from premium models toward broader adoption. Readiness depends on high-voltage component supply, charging infrastructure, thermal design, and service readiness.

documents.title: Silicon carbide drive readiness
documents.content: Silicon carbide inverters improve efficiency and charging performance, but commercialization depends on wafer supply, module packaging, thermal reliability, and cost reduction.

documents.title: Solid-state batteries and distributed drive timelines
documents.content: Solid-state batteries remain less mature for mass-market 2026-2030 products, while distributed drive systems are more likely to appear first in premium, specialty, and autonomy-focused vehicles.
